name: Humboldt County, CA
findings: Humboldt County has 408 nonprofit organizations. 178 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 135 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Humboldt County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
